model_claims.text: The PR adds support for t-string Template objects to the Markup and escape functions.
model_claims.source_quote: This commit adds support for t-strings to both `Markup` and `escape`, essentially matching the handling of `__html__`.

model_claims.text: The PR does not add support for t-strings to Markup.__add__ or Markup.__radd__.
The PR does not add support for t-strings to EscapeFormatter.
model_claims.source_quote: - `EscapeFormatter` as I'm not entirely sure whether / how a template object should interact with format specs.

model_rejected_claims.text: For markupsafe, the literal parts of a t-string are treated as safe (marked as Markup) while the interpolations are treated as unsafe (HTML‑escaped).
model_rejected_claims.source_quote: So for markupsafe the literal parts of the template are considered "safe" and the interpolations are considered unsafe. So for markupsafe the literal parts are `Markup`-ed while the interpolations are `escape`-ed.
